issues.legal_issue: A statutory arrears disqualification requiring non-payment within a specified period after notice is not established by the candidate’s knowledge of the debt when the required notice was not served.
material_facts: The election challenger alleged that the returned candidate had unpaid lease arrears owed to the Board.
The Board certified that it had not issued a demand notice for the lease arrears.
The returned candidate knew of the alleged arrears, but the election court treated that knowledge as satisfying the notice requirement and set aside the election.
issues.conclusion: The statutory disqualification was not established because the required notice had not been served; the candidate’s knowledge of the arrears did not substitute for statutory notice. The orders setting aside the election were reversed and the election petition was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 28(2)(h) of the Cantonments Act, 1924, the disqualification requires failure to pay arrears within thirty days after notice has been served. Section 253(1) prescribes authentication of notices issued under the Act, and Section 254 addresses their service. A person challenging an election on the ground of disqualification bears the evidential burden of establishing the facts that invoke it. Election challenges are statutory proceedings, so statutory requirements must be strictly established; a successful candidate’s election should not be lightly disturbed. No earlier cases are relied on.

predicates.election_disqualification_challenge: A person challenged a returned candidate’s election on the ground that the candidate was disqualified for unpaid arrears.
predicates.arrears_due: The candidate owed arrears to the electoral body.
predicates.required_notice_not_served: The electoral body had not served the notice required before the arrears could give rise to disqualification.

issues.definition: When an election is challenged on the basis of arrears owed by the candidate and the required notice was not served, the arrears disqualification is not established.
